A comprehensive implementation of a thread-safe LRU (Least Recently Used) cache
with Time-To-Live (TTL) expiry functionality.

---------
1. LRU Eviction: Maintains a fixed maximum size. When the cache is full,

   ensure safe concurrent access from multiple threads.
